notes: Invoice Needed uses the Blowout quick line price. Profile Winterization no longer has a separate default amount.
The Invoices tab opens at the top with the newest invoice first.
Customer photos are no longer on the account. A photo already saved on a customer is left off the synced row.
After On My Way opens Messages, Start Directions opens Google Maps turn-by-turn to that stop. Route and Scheduling can turn that off.
A completed or scheduled blowout closes the matching open booking for that customer and address. The request leaves Pending and stays under Approved.
Text Back on a pending text marks that request Replied and takes it off Pending. A later text from that number shows as Pending again. Replied requests stay on the Replied filter.
On Location appears on Home when the phone is within 75 m of a customer address that already has a map point. Route and Scheduling can turn Detect On Location off.
